subject.title: [Feature Request]: Session snapshots — save and load context checkpoints (/session save|load)

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class named session snapshots now, and what initial scope should be supported across arbitrary save/list/load, archive restore, compaction checkpoint branch/restore, and prompt-cache-aware fork?
rationale: The remaining work crosses session-state persistence, destructive restore semantics, archive visibility, provider/model metadata, protocol shape, CLI/chat/UI exposure, and privacy/security policy; automation cannot safely choose that product/API boundary.

options.title: Design Core Snapshot API First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a versioned core contract for named checkpoints, branch/load behavior, retention, privacy, protocol methods, commands, UI exposure, and tests.

options.title: Split Into Narrower Tracks
options.body: Use related issues for checkpoint engine, chat resume, fork/resume, and archive recovery slices while keeping this issue as the umbrella until the full named snapshot contract is ready.

options.title: Defer Named Snapshots
options.body: Continue supporting compaction checkpoints, export commands, and internal fork primitives separately until maintainers decide unified named snapshots are worth the core surface.

recommendation.title: Design Core Snapshot API First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a versioned core contract for named checkpoints, branch/load behavior, retention, privacy, protocol methods, commands, UI exposure, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent product-review signal on this issue and current session-area history.
